title: Every new standard agent gets an unscoped agents:configure grant (edit any agent's instructions); the root CEO's is re-granted at every start
body:
### What happens

Every newly activated standard agent receives the direct grants in `NEW_STANDARD_AGENT_DEFAULT_GRANT_KEYS`, `agents:configure` among them. `newStandardAgentGrantScope` scopes only `tasks:assign_scope` (the agent's subtree) and `inbox:manage`; `agents:configure` gets no scope. It is the grant behind `agent_config:update` and `agent_instructions:update` for any target agent, so every new agent can rewrite the configuration and instructions of every other agent in its company, including agents whose instructions are stricter than its own.

The root CEO additionally gets `agents:configure` and `skills:create` from `ensureRootAgentDefaultChangeGrants`, which `reconcileBuiltInAgentsOnStartup` runs at every server start. No API route removes an agent's grant (#17303), and a grant removed in the database comes back at the next restart.

### Steps

1. Hire a standard (not low-trust) agent A, and any agent B.
2. With A's key, `PUT /api/agents/<B>/instructions-bundle/file` with a changed `AGENTS.md`: 200, B's instructions are replaced.
3. Delete the root CEO's `agents:configure` row and restart the server: the row is back.

In our company a CEO agent that only needed to keep skill selections current rewrote another agent's instructions through this grant.

### Expected

Least privilege by default:

- scope `agents:configure` and `agents:suggest-changes` to the agent itself or its subtree, as `tasks:assign_scope` is, or let the hire/activation request choose the default set;
- apply default grants once, at creation, so a grant an operator removed stays removed.

### Where

- `server/src/lib/agent-permissions.ts:4-28` (defaults and scopes)
- `server/src/services/authorization.ts:2576-2600` (`agent_instructions:update`, `agent_config:update` → `agents:configure`)
- `server/src/services/built-in-agents.ts:488`, `:848-863`, `:2114`, `:2145` (root CEO grants, re-ensured on startup)

### Version

Measured on 2026.1012.0 (self-hosted, authenticated). The same code is on `master` at `41c42895f`.

Related: #17303, #15161, #15315, #17166.
